cohort: A 40-year-old female with a bi-leaflet mechanical prosthetic aortic valve who presented with shortness of breath on the first postpartum day.
finding: A large prosthetic aortic valve thrombus was diagnosed on the first postpartum day in a 40-year-old female with a mechanical prosthetic aortic valve, who had been on enoxaparin throughout pregnancy, requiring emergency surgical thrombectomy.
